title: 第5章 你喜欢吃剩的第6章 落星宗弟子
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 唐天眉头一挑，第一次回唐家，就这么热闹，都会挑日子的吗？
一道气宇轩昂的青色身影，出现在众人眼前。
来人不仅长相俊秀，更有一种难言的气质！
“锻骨境高阶！”
唐天看到面前年轻人的修为，瞳孔不由的收缩。
岁数与自己相同，修为却比堂兄唐风还要高上一筹，足以看出对方的天赋，十分出众。
“唉，看来要抓紧时间提升修为……”
这是唐天心中冒出来的第一个想法。
现在能与焚血境高阶的修者一战，可面对锻骨境的高手，简直就是必死无疑。
“晚辈林逸尘，拜见唐家主、秦伯父。”
年轻人微微一笑，虽然礼貌相待，可任谁都能看出来，对方眼中的高傲。
从称呼上可以看出，林逸尘对待两家的态度了。
未等唐凌云开口，秦天德已经朗声大笑道：“林贤侄，不知道来此有何贵干？”
“秦家主，这是唐家，可不是秦家，你未免有些喧宾夺主了吧？”
唐啸海冷哼一声，既然两家已经闹了不愉快，他可不会给秦天德好脸色。
秦天德脸上的笑容，瞬间一滞，有些尴尬。
唐凌云摆了摆手，示意唐啸海不要出声，看向林逸尘，“林贤侄，不知今日来我唐家，有何贵干？”
林逸尘敢挑这个时候，一个人来唐家，定然不会有什么好事。
唐家和林家的关系，在落星城可是众人皆知，向来不和。
如果不是都互相奈何不了对方的话，怕是早就来一个斩草除根灭门了。
林逸尘点了点头，看了一眼唐天，说道：“晚辈来此，有两件事要办，故而登门打扰，还望唐家主勿怪。”
言语中说的客气，可他的神态，即便是在唐凌云这样的高手面前，也显得极为倨傲。
“但说无妨。”
唐凌云作为唐家家主，自然不会与一个晚辈计较。
林逸尘点了点头，便转身看向唐天，问道：“曾听闻，我三弟与你一起去了落星森林？”
唐天眉头一挑，目光闪烁着锋芒，没有想到对方居然是为了这事情。
要知道，林宝全谎骗原来的“唐天”
，一起去落星森林的外围，为的就是杀掉唐天。
事实上，也达到了目的，只是谁也没有料到后来的结果。
林宝全早就随着自己的那帮小弟，灰飞烟灭，死无对证。
可林家的人，一直不见其踪迹，只有唐天回来了，自然还是要怀疑的。
以唐家和林家的关系，林家的少爷会和唐家的废物少爷在一起，实在是让人匪夷所思了。
唐天如果真的死了，那么林家绝对不敢提及此事。
唐天再怎么废物，那也是唐家的少爷，脸面往往比性命还重要，因而绝对会引起两大家族开战。
可事实是，唐天回了落星城，林宝全下落不明。
唐天点了点头，并没有隐瞒，说道：“我确实和林宝全去了落星森林，只是后来遇到了一只强大的妖兽，走散了。”
“什么妖兽？”
content_en:
Tang Tian raised his eyebrows. It was the first time he returned to the Tang family. It was so lively. Did he choose the day?
An imposing green figure appeared in front of everyone.
The person who came here was not only handsome, but also had an indescribable temperament!
"High-level Bone Forging Realm!"
Tang Tian's pupils couldn't help but shrink when he saw the cultivation level of the young man in front of him.
He is the same age as himself, but his cultivation is higher than that of his cousin Tang Feng, which is enough to tell that the other party's talent is outstanding.
"Oh, it seems that we need to seize the time to improve our cultivation..."
This was the first thought that came to Tang Tian's mind.
Now he can fight against high-level cultivators of the Burning Blood Realm, but facing masters of the Bone Forging Realm, he is almost certain to die.
"Junior Lin Yichen, pay homage to the head of the Tang family and Uncle Qin."
The young man smiled slightly. Although he was polite, anyone could see the arrogance in the other person's eyes.
From the title, we can see Lin Yichen's attitude towards the two families.
Before Tang Lingyun could speak, Qin Tiande laughed loudly and said, "Nephew Lin, why are you here?"
"Master of the Qin family, this is the Tang family, not the Qin family. Are you a bit overestimating it?"
Tang Xiaohai snorted coldly. Since the two families were already in trouble, he would not give Qin Tiande a good look.
"Uh..."
The smile on Qin Tiande's face froze for a moment, feeling a little embarrassed.
Tang Lingyun waved his hand, signaling Tang Xiaohai to be silent, and looked at Lin Yichen, "Nephew Lin, I wonder why you came to my Tang family today?"
If Lin Yichen dared to choose this time to come to the Tang family alone, nothing good would happen.
The relationship between the Tang family and the Lin family is well known in Luo Xing City and they have always been at odds.
If they hadn't been unable to do anything to each other, I'm afraid they would have wiped out the whole family long ago.
Lin Yichen nodded, glanced at Tang Tian, and said, "This junior has two things to do when he comes here, so he comes to disturb us. I hope the Tang family master won't be surprised."
His words were polite, but his demeanor looked extremely arrogant even in front of a master like Tang Lingyun.
"But it doesn't matter."
As the head of the Tang family, Tang Lingyun would naturally not argue with a junior.
"Okay!"
Lin Yichen nodded, turned to look at Tang Tian, and asked, "Have you ever heard that my third brother went to Luo Xing Forest with you?"
Tang Tian raised his brows and his eyes flashed with sharpness. He didn't expect that the other party was actually doing it for this matter.
You know, Lin Baoquan lied to the original "Tang Tian"
, go to the outskirts of Luo Xing Forest together in order to kill Tang Tian.
In fact, the goal was achieved, but no one expected the subsequent results.
Lin Baoquan followed his gang of brothers and perished with no evidence.
But there was no trace of the Lin family, and only Tang Tian came back, so naturally he still had to be suspicious.
Considering the relationship between the Tang family and the Lin family, it is really unbelievable that the young master of the Lin family would be with the good-for-nothing young master of the Tang family.
If Tang Tian was really dead, the Lin family would never dare to mention it.
No matter how useless Tang Tian is, he is still the young master of the Tang family. His face is often more important than his life, so he will definitely cause a war between the two families.
But the fact is that Tang Tian returned to Falling Star City, and Lin Baoquan's whereabouts were unknown.
Tang Tian nodded, without concealing anything, and said, "I did go to Luo Xing Forest with Lin Baoquan, but later we encountered a powerful monster and got separated."
"What monster?"
